vector_table.note: Flash origin is a 44-byte Cortex-M / Infineon header (typed CortexMBootVectorHeader as g_sBootVectorHeader) then 8 bytes of InitializeCRuntimeEntry. Only SP and Reset are live Thumb vectors. NMI and HardFault are 0. There is no SVCall/PendSV/SysTick/IRQ pointer in this header; those slots are metadata then code. XMC1302 has 16 system + 32 IRQ = 48 vector words; HandleResetStartup fills that many slots in SRAM at 0x20000000.

entries.name: InitialSP
entries.meaning: MSP top (SRAM). Same value as g_dwInitialStackPointer / GetUserStackHeapBounds stack top.

entries.name: NMI
entries.meaning: Unused. Template stub HandleNmiInterrupt @ 0x10003AA4 is not referenced.

entries.name: HardFault
entries.meaning: Unused. Template stub HandleHardFault @ 0x10003AA6 is not referenced.

entries.name: ReservedOrMeta0
entries.meaning: Not a flash Thumb pointer (would be MemManage on M3; unused on M0).

entries.name: ReservedOrMeta1
entries.meaning: Not a flash Thumb pointer (BusFault on M3; unused on M0).

entries.name: HeaderMagicOrCrc
entries.meaning: Not a code address; likely Infineon header CRC/magic.

entries.name: CRuntimeAddr
entries.meaning: Even pointer to ARMCC __main (not Thumb-tagged). Reset jumps there via BX 0x1000102D.

entries.name: FlashChkEnd
entries.meaning: Flash pointer (checksum/range end). Bytes there are 00 00 00 00 then repeating 2F 48 FE E7.

entries.name: InitializeCRuntimeEntry
entries.meaning: CODE not a vector: BL RunScatterLoadInitTable (00 F0 02 F8). Would be SVCall if this were a full table.

entries.name: InitializeCRuntimeEntry+4
entries.meaning: CODE: BL InvokeMainAfterRuntimeInit (00 F0 3E F8). Function body ends 0x10001033; next function RunScatterLoadInitTable is owned by periph-low.

functions.purpose: ARMCC __main thunk: BL RunScatterLoadInitTable; BL InvokeMainAfterRuntimeInit. Reset BX-targets this. Decompiler inlines the following scatterload because the first BL lands on the next instruction (PIC LR trick); stored body is only 8 bytes. Locals in that decompilation belong to RunScatterLoadInitTable — not renamed here.

Cortex-M Reset: LDR/MOV MSP=0x20003210 (decompiler omits as prologue), fill 48 words at 0x20000000 with g_dwRamVectorFillWord, BLX InitializeCmsisSystemCore, BLX InvokeEmptyLibcInit, BX InitializeCRuntimeEntry.
CMSIS-order NMI lockup (B .). Flash NMI vector is 0; no Thumb pointer to 0x10003AA5 in the image.
CMSIS-order HardFault lockup (B .). Flash HardFault vector is 0; no Thumb pointer to 0x10003AA7 in the image.
CMSIS-order SVCall lockup (B .). Not present in the 13-word flash header.
CMSIS-order PendSV lockup (B .). Not present in the 13-word flash header.
CMSIS-order SysTick lockup (B .). Not present in the 13-word flash header.
CMSIS Default_Handler lockup (B .). Last of six consecutive B . after Reset. IRQs are not in the flash header.

globals_named.name: g_adwMotorScaleConstPool
globals_named.note: Orphaned pool after ComputeMotorScaleTables (body_end 0x100039F1). Mix of floats and RAM pointers (first dword 0x200025CC).

variable_coverage.note: Only HandleResetStartup has decompiler locals. Six lockup stubs and the 8-byte __main thunk have none. InitializeCRuntimeEntry decompile listing leaks RunScatterLoadInitTable SSA names; those were left untouched (other agent owns 0x10001034+).
